profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Expertise in the development and support of multi-threaded, low latency, real-time pricing and synthetic order management systems written in C++.  Worked as lead developer on complex development projects, owning trading support on key products.

Skilled in programming high risk projects while managing requirements, and design trade-offs, to maximize speed of delivery, maintainability and functionality.

Proficient in C++, SQLServer, Sybase, Perl, Linux

    · MSEE, University of Illinois at Urbana 

    . CFA Charterholder ('07-'09)

Specialties: Real-time Market Data, Synthetic Order Management, Finance

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description: Conceptualized and developed the crypto derivatives risk server in the trading-core team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Led rewrite of firm's tick market data systems for various exchanges including Nasdaq, Fenics. Built interchangeable components for decoding and building order books.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: Lead developer for rewrite of Order and Quote routing server for the firm.  Developed and put into production this server for a large option exchange and a large futures exchange.  Provide production support as well as feature enhancements.  This server is written in C++.

positions.title: Senior Architect
positions.description:
Maintained and added to TT's price and contract subscription layer that enables server products and client apps such as X Trader to publish and receive real time market update. This layer sits above network messaging layer and provides management, recovery of subscriptions and delivery of real time events.

Responsible for software support and development of TT's Synthetic Strategy Engine (SSE). SSE manages trader orders allowing them to submit order types not supported by the exchange or by TT's order routing servers (e.g. time slicers, machine gun). In this role, I diagnose production problems, design software fixes as well as add new features (e.g. new synthetic order types).

positions.title: Architect
positions.description:
Team lead and architect responsible for the integration between the firms portfolio accounting system (Eagle), trade order management system (Charles River), and legacy systems.  

Architected a transaction level integration between Calamos Eagle Star Portfolio Accounting System and Lehman Point Portfolio Management and Analytics System.  

Formulated architectural alternatives for implementing security referential, corporate actions, pricing and FX data flow.  Performed analysis of Charles River trade management and Eagle portfolio accounting system data interfaces during the trade order management and portfolio accounting system build vs. buy evaluation period.  

Managed the development of the firm’s S&P Compustat XpressFeed acquisition system.

Responsible for extension and support of daily mutual fund pricing system used to strike the NAV for all Calamos funds.

positions.title: Development Lead
positions.description:
Wrote Citadel's Corporate Bond Pricing (CBP) system.  CBP enables the acquisition and review of pricing data and its mapping to Citadel referential data for the credit desk.  CBP creates a stream of bid/ask and volume data for corporate bonds based on broker published emails with which trading decisions may be made.   A broker/firm directed grammar based parsing approach that incorporates user feedback and layout information was used.  CBP was developed using VC++, Perl, and Sybase.

Worked on G5, enterprise vendor referential data acquisition and arbitration system.  G5 is based on the Asset Control (AC) platform and enables Citadel to create and maintain referential data for the entire firm.  Wrote integration and arbitration methods for Bloomberg and Reuters securities data that applied Citadel specific rules on creating gold copies of data.

positions.title: National e-Business Practice Director, Principal Consultant
positions.description:
A solid track record as practice director, engagement manager, project manager, and developer.  Conceptualized and started the e-business national practice.  

Reuters,  1993 –1995  Developed a fault tolerant messaging architecture for a Trader's Information Architecture (TRIARCH) pricing server that provides comprehensive, multi-source online stock and commodity information. 

Insurance Auto Auctions Inc., 2002 - 2003  As lead business analyst for the project, managed the creation of subsystem business and technical requirements. Managed the development of the Affiliates Vehicle Processing subsystem.

RadioWave.com,  1997 – 1999  A Motorola subsidiary, RadioWave.com desired to build a new business around a consumer directed Internet radio web site.  Served as chief software architect.  

VideOcart Inc.,  1991 - 1993  Developed critical operational applications for VideoCart, an electronic merchandising system. 
.
